items.title: Booking Holdings earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Booking Holdings (BKNG) is trading at $172.72 (+10.95%) as of Nov 4, 12:24 PM EST. That is a reversal from the after-hours dip to $155.17 on Nov 3. The Q3 report (Nov 3) was a mixed print: an EPS beat and a revenue miss against consensus. Q4 guidance was soft, yet the stock still jumped. The market appears to have been braced for worse.

items.title: Booking Holdings’ Lowest Recent Target Still Implies 22% Upside. Airbnb’s Growth Tests the Estimates Behind It
items.summary: Key TakeawaysEvery recent price target on Booking Holdings (BKNG:NASDAQ) is above the stock, from Wells Fargo’s $190 to UBS’s $265, even after a 27% drop this year.
